question: Which mouth-born means enable the grace-bestowing beings to confer grace upon all creatures?
premises: The preceding verses identify beings intent on grace toward devotees.
These grace-bestowing beings range from the smallest to the largest, moving and unmoving.
Initiation, exposition, touch, glance, and speech are presented as mouth-born means.
inference: The grace-bestowing beings confer grace through initiation, exposition, touch, glance, and speech arising from the mouth.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation among the listed items is compressed in this verse.
The form saṃsparśā is taken as a nominative plural in context despite its surface spelling.
plain_english: Initiation, exposition, touch, glance, and speech, born from the mouth, are the means by which they bestow grace.
